svg.text: Aether Codebase Highlights
Monorepo | Next.js + Node.js | Privacy-First Resilience Platform
1) What The Codebase Does
• Delivers a student resilience experience with journaling and guidance.
• Frontend includes pages for Echo journaling, peer navigation,
resilience pathways, blog, and support-oriented content.
• Supports retrieval-augmented guidance via a generated RAG index.
• Includes a backend HTTP service currently focused on health checks
and API extension readiness.
2) Architecture and Organization
• Monorepo with npm workspaces:
apps/frontend (Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind)
apps/backend (Node.js HTTP service)
content/blog (Markdown content source)
docs (architecture, algorithms, contracts)
• Clear separation between UI, content, docs, and services.
3) Engineering Quality Signals
• Root scripts define consistent checks: lint, typecheck, test, build.
• Automated frontend + backend test execution from root workspace.
• Production deployment guidance for Vercel, Netlify, and Docker.
• Architecture and feature docs are mature and easy to navigate.
4) Quick Assessment
• Organization: Strong (modular, well-documented, clear boundaries).
• Product maturity: Frontend-rich with strong content and UX surface.
• Backend maturity: Lightweight today; structured to scale APIs/jobs.
• Maintainability: Good due to workspaces, scripts, and docs quality.
Generated summary scope: README, ARCHITECTURE docs, workspace layout, package scripts, and backend entrypoints.
